threat_event: Browser form-grabber or memory-scraping malware on front office PCs captures card numbers keyed from phone calls and forms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card numbers keyed into PMS on general-purpose PCs; flat staff network; anti-malware only (no EDR); no phishing training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 front office PCs; SYS-01; SYS-06
existing_controls: Anti-malware; monthly patching; firewall blocks inbound
treatment_plan: Stop keyed entry on PCs: move phone and form payments to P2PE device keypads and gateway payment links; EDR with 24x7 alerting through the MSP; payment VLAN

threat_event: Theft of card authorization forms stored in shared mailboxes and the front desk binder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,140 emails with card numbers (212 with security codes) since 2021; unlocked paper binder; no retention limit
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-11 reservations and sales mailboxes; front desk binder
existing_controls: Mailbox access limited to reservations and sales staff; MFA on email
treatment_plan: Purge stored card data from mailboxes and paper after secure processing; replace emailed forms with gateway payment links; lock and then retire the binder

threat_event: Attacker who compromises any staff PC moves laterally to front desk PCs and terminals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat staff network for front desk, back office, lock server, and CCTV; no segmentation
existing_controls: Guest networks separated; inbound blocked at firewall
treatment_plan: Separate payment, lock, CCTV, and office VLANs with deny-by-default rules; document segmentation and test it

threat_event: Stolen front desk credentials used to sign in to the PMS, display full virtual card numbers, and export guest profiles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA for non-administrator PMS users; 14 of 22 users can display full card numbers; shared night audit account
treatment_plan: Single sign-on with MFA for all PMS users; remove card-display permission from 11 users; named night audit accounts

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP or lock vendor remote access tool gives attackers access to every staff PC and the lock server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote tools with no MFA and no source restriction; no vendor security review
existing_controls: MSP contract; vendor accounts are named
treatment_plan: MFA and source-IP restriction on both tools; on-demand vendor sessions approved by IT; annual vendor security review

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported lock server operating system to disrupt guest room access or pivot to the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system out of vendor support since 2023; on flat network; not patched
treatment_plan: Isolate lock server on its own VLAN now; upgrade lock server software and operating system with the lock vendor

threat_event: Attacker uses the lock vendor's default administrator password to issue master key cards or change lock settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor default administrator password on the lock server (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Lock server in a locked back office
treatment_plan: Change default password immediately; named administrator accounts; review master key issuance log weekly

threat_event: Acquirer fees or loss of card acceptance because the 2025 SAQ was wrong and the 2026 SAQ D is not completed on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 SAQ A signed without scoping; no scope document; SAQ D requirements largely unmet
treatment_plan: Scope document and data-flow diagram; SAQ D evidence file; engage a QSA for a scoping review; submit by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Former employee signs in to the PMS after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 PMS accounts of former employees active; no termination checklist for PMS
existing_controls: HR emails the Front Office Manager at termination
treatment_plan: Same-day disable through single sign-on; quarterly PMS account review

threat_event: Card numbers that guests type into the chatbot are kept in vendor transcripts and exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No input masking; 23 transcripts with card numbers; transcripts kept indefinitely
existing_controls: Chatbot tells guests to book through the booking engine
treatment_plan: Card-number detection and masking in chat; purge existing transcripts; 90-day transcript retention in contract

threat_event: Chatbot quotes nightly rates without the mandatory $35 amenity fee
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot pulls base rate from PMS availability, not total price
treatment_plan: Quote total price including amenity fee; test script before each release (P10)

threat_event: Automatically published rates during a declared state of emergency are treated as unconscionable prices
threat_source: AI pricing model; hurricane demand surge
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No emergency cap or human review in the revenue-management system
treatment_plan: Emergency mode: freeze rates at the 30-day average when a state of emergency is declared; human approval of increases (P10)

threat_event: Antitrust claims because the pricing vendor pools the hotel's non-public rate and occupancy data with competitors' data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract allows pooled benchmarking; no legal review of the feature
treatment_plan: Opt out of pooled benchmarking; counsel review of the contract

threat_event: PMS vendor outage longer than the 4-hour RTO stops check-in, check-out, and key cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; no downtime procedure; vendor RTO not in contract
treatment_plan: Downtime procedures (paper arrivals list, emergency key cards); add RTO and RPO to contract

threat_event: Hurricane forces evacuation or closure and damages on-site IT, including the lock server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IT not in the hurricane plan; lock server and network gear on the ground floor; no offsite recovery for the lock server
treatment_plan: IT section of the hurricane plan; raise and protect network and lock gear; cloud backup and tested rebuild of the lock server; cellular failover

threat_event: Internet outage stops the PMS, front desk terminals, and online bookings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider
treatment_plan: Second provider or cellular failover for the staff network

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts back office PCs, the lock server, and the file share, and deletes backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in the same cloud account; never restore-tested; no EDR
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; quarterly restore tests; EDR (R-001)

threat_event: Skimming overlay or swapped device at the front desk or a pay-at-table handheld
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No scheduled inspections; device list not reconciled
existing_controls: P2PE devices in restaurant; terminals in staffed areas
treatment_plan: Device inventory; weekly inspection log; staff training on tampering

threat_event: Caller impersonates a guest to obtain a room number, folio, or card details from the front desk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No caller verification procedure; no training
existing_controls: Informal practice of not giving room numbers
treatment_plan: Caller verification script; training; no card details by phone

threat_event: Breach of 61,000 ID scans kept in the PMS triggers Florida notice for passport and driver license numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ID scans kept indefinitely; no retention schedule
treatment_plan: Retention schedule: delete ID scans after checkout plus 30 days; register data 2 years (Fla. Stat. 509.101(2))

threat_event: Guest on hotel Wi-Fi attacks other guests or reaches the staff network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared guest network
treatment_plan: Accepted by General Manager: residual risk Low; vendor controls confirmed in contract

threat_event: Channel manager without a PCI attestation exposes online travel agency virtual card numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AOC on file; no responsibility matrix
treatment_plan: Obtain current AOC; add PCI responsibility matrix; replace vendor if not provided by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Guest-marketing database or PMS report exports in cloud storage exposed by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration review; exports kept without limit
existing_controls: Private storage by default; provider encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Monthly configuration check; 90-day export retention; alert on public access

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two administrators with standing access
treatment_plan: Accepted by General Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Staff do not report a suspected compromise, so acquirer, card brand, and Florida deadlines are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reporting channel; no incident response plan
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook; reporting line in training

threat_event: Intrusion goes undetected for months because no logs are collected or reviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log collection from firewall, PCs, or lock server; PMS reports not reviewed
treatment_plan: Central log service through the MSP with 12-month retention; daily alert review; weekly PMS activity review

threat_event: Background-check reports disposed of without destruction
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reports printed and filed in HR; no disposal procedure
treatment_plan: Disposal procedure and destruction records

threat_event: Finger templates from the time clocks are exposed in a vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor security not reviewed
treatment_plan: Vendor security review; confirm template encryption and deletion at termination

threat_event: Revenue-management model sets rates far below cost or above market for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No override thresholds; no monitoring of model output
treatment_plan: Floor and ceiling rates; daily exception report; human approval above thresholds (P10)

threat_event: Chatbot gives wrong policy information (cancellation, accessibility, pets) to guests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No answer testing; no human handoff rule
existing_controls: Chatbot limited to the hotel FAQ
treatment_plan: Monthly answer testing; handoff to staff for policy questions (P10)

threat_event: FTC unfairness action after a card breach because security was not reasonable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several gaps match the practices alleged in FTC v. Wyndham (clear-text card data, default passwords, flat network, vendor access, weak detection)
treatment_plan: Execute P07 POA&M; annual risk assessment
